**Risk flags**

- Director 2 holds 63.4 % of shares  

**Overview**  
Mutiara Seri Runcit Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited retail company that operates a convenience store selling daily necessities in Kuala Lumpur. The company was incorporated on 11 December 2005 and has a share capital of RM100,000. It has three directors, with Director 2 owning the majority stake (63.4 %). No corporate shareholders are listed. The latest audited financials (2024) show an unqualified audit opinion.
